name: B10-0441/2026 (S&D) – The 2026 undemocratic elections to the Russian State Duma and its implications on civil society
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the undemocratic elections in the Russia State Duma and their implications for civil society
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russia's September 2026 parliamentary elections as undemocratic. It says they took place without real competition, under repression and fear, with candidates blocked and independent observers kept out. It also rejects the voting held in occupied parts of Ukraine as illegal. The text is an opinion and a set of calls, not a law. It asks the European Union to keep supporting Russian civil society, independent media and the democratic opposition, and repeats its demand that Russia end its war against Ukraine.

- The Parliament states its position; no law or rule changes for anyone.
- It backs Russian civil society, independent media and the opposition.
- It calls on Russia to stop the war and withdraw from Ukraine.
